title: FileSystem, script reorder, index out of bounds
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in:
v4.8.dev2.official [7220d456d]
v4.7.1.stable.official [a13da4feb]

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev2 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Dragging a script in the FileSystem panel, to or from a folder shows:
>  ERROR: editor/editor_data.cpp:837 - Index p_idx = 2 is out of bounds (edited_scene.size() = 2).
>  ERROR: scene/gui/tab_bar.cpp:830 - Index p_current = 2 is out of bounds (get_tab_count() = 2).


### Steps to reproduce

- open project: [script_reorder_index_out_of_bounds.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30541989/script_reorder_index_out_of_bounds.zip)
- in the FileSystem panel, unfold the folder: folder
open: scene1.tscn
open: scene2.tscn
- drag the script: scene2_script.gd
to: res://
- on the Please Confirm... dialog, click: OK

### Issue
The Output panel shows:
>  ERROR: scene/gui/tab_bar.cpp:830 - Index p_current = 1 is out of bounds (get_tab_count() = 1).

- on the scene tab bar, click + to add a new empty scene
- drag the script: scene2_script.gd
to: folder
Now it shows another error, before the one above:
>  ERROR: editor/editor_data.cpp:837 - Index p_idx = 2 is out of bounds (edited_scene.size() = 2).
>  ERROR: scene/gui/tab_bar.cpp:830 - Index p_current = 2 is out of bounds (get_tab_count() = 2).

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c67a6e7c-c6bd-48ff-8c9b-77d509f8af34

### Expected
No errors.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[script_reorder_index_out_of_bounds.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30541989/script_reorder_index_out_of_bounds.zip)
